description: one row per unused label, label group, IP list and service (each kind by name; a kind a list not read in full may hold is left out, see meta.hygiene.withheld), then one per workload missing label keys (in list order); unused rows are candidates: meta.not_searched names what may still use them

name.description: key=value for a label; a workload's hostname, else its name

reason.description: unused, or for a workload: missing labels: app,env

missing.description: workload: the label keys it lacks; null for the other kinds

certain.description: false: the verdict rests on rulesets whose deny rules were not read, which may name the object; workloads are always true

usage.$comment: label: the PCE's usage object (GET /labels?usage=true), passed through; null when it returned none and for the other kinds
